question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

My partner and I has become increasingly alienated from each other.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the verb "**has**" instead of "**have**".
 
• Since the subject is **"My partner and I"**, which is a compound subject, it requires the plural verb "**have**".
 
• The correct phrase should be "**have become increasingly**", ensuring grammatical correctness.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"My partner and I **have become increasingly** alienated from each other."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1) No error** – This option would be correct if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in Option 2.
 
• **3) My partner and I** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4) alienated from each other.** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
